caption: The video captures a low, close view of a small rocky stream. A short cascade of white, aerated water tumbles through a gap between rounded boulders and splashes into a shallow, murky tan pool. Large gray and moss-green stones frame the upper and right edges, while a smooth yellowish stone sits at the far right. Submerged rounded stones remain visible through the brownish foreground water. The frothy cascade churns continuously, its foam patch staying centered while splashes and bubble clusters change from moment to moment. Ripples and bright highlights move across the pool surface, especially in the foreground. Small bubbles and foam patches appear, drift briefly, and vanish near the base of the cascade. The arrangement of rocks stays fixed throughout, and the water continues flowing across the frame.
